explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 66 configurations over 9 sweeps (colocated, colocated-tuned, pd-ratio, pd-always, pd-wide-decode, pd-wide-prefill, pd-pool-engine, pd-decode-cudagraph, routing), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 72 GPUs.
9x TP8 + EP (batch tokens 32,768), from the colocated-tuned sweep, reached 22.77 tok/s/accelerator (1639.3 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 512 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
9x TP8 + EP (batch tokens 32,768) at concurrency 512. 264 of 264 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
recommendation_prose: The table below ranks the measured operating points by output tok/s per accelerator, the objective this experiment selects on, among runs that held the scenario's SLOs.

prose: Nine TP8 instances should lead the colocated shapes, since wider dp groups paid hundreds of ms of ITL on the 64-GPU rack.
Measured: best was 9x TP8 + EP at 22.1 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 512).
sections.title: Sweep: colocated

prose: A bigger token budget with a long-prefill cap should hold ITL to higher load, narrowing what P/D can win.
Measured: best was 9x TP8 + EP (batch tokens 32,768) at 22.77 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 512).
sections.title: Sweep: colocated-tuned

prose: Decode-heavy ratios should win on AgentX, since cached prefixes leave only a short uncached tail to prefill per turn.
Measured: best was 5P/4D TP8 + EP at 19.82 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-ratio

prose: Splitting every request should trail the threshold arms, because a turn with a cached prefix pays a handoff for little prefill.
Measured: best was 5P/4D TP8 + EP at 19.65 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-always

prose: TP16 decode instances should hold ITL at higher load than TP8 ones, trading batch slots for faster steps.
Measured: best was 5P TP8 + EP / 2D TP16 + EP at 17.8 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-wide-decode

prose: TP16 prefill instances should cut TTFT on long cold turns but cost decode slots, so they should lose on ITL-bound load.
Measured: best was 2P TP16 + EP / 5D TP8 + EP at 19.61 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-wide-prefill

prose: A 32k prefill budget should matter on the prefill-light layout and a decode-pool prefill cap on the decode-heavy one.
Measured: best was 4P/5D TP8 + EP at 19.03 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-pool-engine

prose: Full graph capture on the decode pool should lower ITL by a few percent, with FULL_DECODE_ONLY matching FULL there.
Measured: best was 3P/6D TP8 + EP at 19.44 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-decode-cudagraph

prose: Prefix affinity should beat load-only scorers, and by more across nine instances than three.
Measured: best was 9x TP8 + EP at 21.51 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: routing
